🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) ↑ rising and SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION show mixed risk signals alongside resilient sector breadth.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Precious metals and commodities strength: SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND signal safe-haven/commodity demand. Credit and volatility mixed: HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION — HYG/LQD mildly ↑ rising while VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) ↑ rising keeps watch.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION and muted moves in credit (HYG/LQD mixed) imply stable but watchful financial conditions.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals/commodities leading: XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION. Style: Cyclicals/Commodities showing strength, Tech showing weakness.

5. US vs Global?
Domestic large cap muted: SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION, while EM outperformance: EEM (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +9.23%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +3.53%) CORRECTION show regional divergence.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation intact: IBIT (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +1.73% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND rising, though VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) ↑ rising warrants monitoring.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metal strength prominent: SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND and PPLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +24.74%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +9.27%) CORRECTION shows 1W pullback inside a stronger 1M trend.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy robust: BNO (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +9.71%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: IWM (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND show aligned 1W/1M momentum. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR Divergence across SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION — short-term pullbacks amid 1M strength.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/commodities exposure (XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging Tech (XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION, QQQ (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION); monitor VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION for risk pivot.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials/Precious metals — XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Communication/Tech pressure — XLC (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -0.95%) BELOW TREND, XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Precious metals (SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND, PPLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +24.74%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%) BELOW TREND and select agri (CORN (1W: -3.97% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (vol complacency/entry for risk), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/benchmark relative gap (tech vs cyclicals pivot) — watch these as early signals of regime tilt.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, mixed risk proxies and muted financial conditions. Commodities and cyclicals showing relative strength — SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION showing weakness. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION — monitor for a clean directional resolve.
